steps.title: Obtain a police report for the lost NIC
steps.description: Report the loss at your nearest police station and obtain a complaint reference / police report. This is mandatory for a lost-card replacement.

steps.title: Prepare your birth certificate
steps.description: An original birth certificate is required to verify your identity for the duplicate.

steps.title: Complete and certify the application (Form RG-D-01)
steps.description: Fill the duplicate NIC application and have it certified by the Grama Niladhari of your division.

steps.title: Obtain the required photographs
steps.description: Provide studio photographs meeting the DRP specification (digital or printed as instructed at the office).

steps.title: Submit at the Divisional Secretariat / DRP and pay the fee
steps.description: Hand over the certified application with supporting documents to the Divisional Secretariat or DRP and pay the applicable fee.

steps.title: Collect your duplicate NIC
steps.description: Collect the duplicate National Identity Card once issued.
